name: Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20
short_description: A Novotel between BTS Asok and Phrom Phong with a rooftop bar overlooking Benjakitti Park and a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle to the Skytrain.
ai_summary: Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20 sits on Soi Sukhumvit 20 between BTS Asok and Phrom Phong stations, within walking distance of Terminal 21 and the EmQuartier and Emporium malls -- a different property from the brand's Novotel Bangkok Platinum Pratunam location. Independent reviews from 2017 through 2025 consistently praise room comfort, cleanliness and staff friendliness, and the 26th-floor Sky on 20 rooftop bar overlooking Benjakitti Park is a recurring highlight. The main watchouts are shower-only bathrooms across most room categories and a genuine 8-15 minute walk to the BTS despite a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle, while breakfast and rooftop-bar experiences get mixed marks in some reviews.

faqs.question: How far is Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20 from Suvarnabhumi Airport?
faqs.answer: It's roughly 28 km, about a 30-minute drive depending on traffic, from Suvarnabhumi International Airport, located in the Sukhumvit district between BTS Asok and Phrom Phong Skytrain stations.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20 within walking distance of the BTS Skytrain?
faqs.answer: It's a genuine 8-15 minute walk rather than immediate access, but the hotel runs a complimentary tuk-tuk shuttle to BTS Asok and Phrom Phong stations for guests who prefer not to walk.

reviews.title: Novotel Bangkok Sukhumvit 20: A Convenient and Affordable Hotel

reviews.summary: Praises Thai-modern design, comfortable rooms and strong water pressure, but notes shower-only bathrooms and no hotel-run breakfast venue.
